primary.title: Gold, silver prices today: Comex gold and silver edge lower amid Middle East tensions, firm US dollar
primary.summary: Precious metals declined on 7 July amid rising tensions in the Middle East and ahead of Federal Reserve meeting minutes. Gold and silver futures fell sharply, continuously influenced by international geopolitical concerns and fluctuations in the US dollar and crude oil prices.
